About Alexis de Tocqueville

Alexis de Tocqueville (1805–1859) was a French aristocrat, magistrate, and political thinker whose Democracy in America interpreted the United States as the advance guard of modern equality. An 1831 journey ostensibly studying prisons yielded a classic of political sociology.

How to read this passage

Social philosophy asks how individuals and collectives constitute each other, and what justice requires of shared life. This passage enters that discussion through society.
